lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a regular grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with circular blobs to form a regular coordinate system of high-contrast nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and lower intensity shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Presence of sparsely distributed, high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin mask, concentrated primarily towards the posterior edge.
